name: jev-with-style
description: Jev (TypeSafe AI) questions and thresholds managed as Quonfig config: typed, targetable, editable without a deploy.

scripts.typecheck:examples: tsc -p examples/1-inline && tsc -p examples/2-knobs && tsc -p examples/4-all-config && tsc -p examples/5-declared && tsc -p examples/6-live
scripts.generate:examples: qfg generate --targets node-ts --dir examples/2-knobs/quonfig -o examples/2-knobs/generated && qfg generate --targets node-ts --dir examples/4-all-config/quonfig -o examples/4-all-config/generated
scripts.verify:examples: qfg verify examples/2-knobs/quonfig && qfg verify examples/4-all-config/quonfig && qfg verify examples/5-declared/quonfig
